  PROBLEM: `_tg_delete_msg_checked` treats any Telegram reply with `.ok == false` as a finished delete unless the HTTP status is 429 or 5xx, so 401 and 403 count as success.

Severity disagreement: sonnet-5.5 rated it NIT, gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. The highest is used. The mapping of MAJOR to "high" is an assumption.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:173-181,274,400-405,486-491,567-572 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `tg_marker_ids` calls bare `capture($re)` without handling a non-match, which the reviewers say aborts the jq program on a trusted author's non-marker comment.
  WHY: The reviewers say cleanup aborts with "Unparsable issue comments page" and the store path creates a new tracking comment instead of appending. Disputed: sonnet-5.5 and glm-5.3-flash investigated and rejected the claim, because jq `capture` yields no output on no-match and the existing tests pass. Severity is MAJOR for the reviewers who reported it.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:1451-1485 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `not_initialized` early-exit in "Collect validation status" depends only on RUNTIME_DIR. If "Fetch workflow support files" fails after the runtime setup succeeds, the step falls through to `raw_status=codex_failure` with "Missing status artifact".
  WHY: A support-staging failure is misreported as a validation-process failure, which is the misleading follow-on message the PR set out to remove. The job still fails through "Enforce validation outcome", so the impact is diagnostic only.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:328 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The login regex `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38}$` rejects logins with an underscore or more than 39 characters, so they fall back to `github-actions[bot]`.
  WHY: Markers written under such a PAT owner would never be trusted. sonnet-5.5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion. glm-5.3-flash rejected it, saying GitHub logins cannot contain underscores.
